Jackie, saw PandaDoc raise from Indico to expand AI, cross $100M ARR, and bring Keith in as CEO.

I built a personalized signal play for PandaDoc off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
